acceptance.G0: Pinned provenance, one complete level-0 patch and 11 common times, float64 diagnostics, correct 51200 particles; false -> INCONCLUSIVE, no physics result
acceptance.G1_G5: Use same previous single-case G1-G5 thresholds; new 128-cell run must independently pass all
acceptance.I0: Initial circular complex first harmonic on 128 physical dual nodes within 2% of delta 0.01, phase and wrong helicity within 2% of delta; background Bx=1
acceptance.I1: Initial weighted ion number equals L n0=6.4, and initial deposited charge integral within 1e-8; thermal K and momentum differences reported as noise proxies NOT exact matching required
acceptance.S1: Max complex first harmonic new-minus-64 reference /0.01 <= 0.02 (absolute 2.0e-4)
acceptance.S2: Max initial-subtracted ion kinetic and transverse magnetic exchange differences separately /0.00032 <=0.03 (absolute 9.6e-6)
acceptance.S4: Initial distribution noise indicators and spatial amplitude/leakage reported; one seed not sufficient for statistical confidence or convergence order

case.initial_fields: Bx=1; By=0.01*cos(2*pi*x/L); Bz=0.01*sin(2*pi*x/L), sampled at PHARE's proper field centre; ion u=0
case.name: P1_grid_128_fixed_ppc

grid_control.reason: Demand one complete level-0 patch to preserve audited single-patch HDF5 contract; no AMR.

particle_sampling.uncontrolled_noise_limitation: Same seed does NOT imply identical particles when grid and macro count change; not pure truncation-error isolation.

scientific_restrictions: One grid pair, one seed, same ppc but different macro-particle realisations; NOT an asymptotic grid-convergence study
New 128-cell patch size is explicitly fixed to 128 in this 1D scenario; does not independently validate SAMRAI patch adaptation
No extrapolation to 2D, 3D, magnetic inflation, current closure, solar-wind obstacle, L1 protection, or other IPLS designations
scope: ONE 128-cell periodic ideal hybrid 1D grid sensitivity screen; NO SOLAR WIND OR OBSTACLE
